newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska Public 650 MW unit seen down until Sunday.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska Public 650 MW unit seen down until Sunday.

text.p: Nebraska Public Power District's 650 megawatt (MW) Gerald Gentleman coal-fired power unit 2 was expected to return to service Dec 8 after being taken off line Monday for repairs, a spokeswoman said.
The unit, located near Sutherland, Neb., was taken off line early Monday for repairs to a generator, the company spokeswoman said.
The Gerald Gentleman station is made up of two 650 MW units. Unit 1 continues to operate normally, the spokeswoman said.
Nebraska Public is the sole owner and operator of the Gerald Gentleman plant.
